paragraphs: Ashtor. Binyamin bar Ashtor — Bikkurim, chapter 1, halakhah 4.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The source explicitly names Bikkurim; its corpus and edition are unstated. פ״א ה״ד gives chapter 1, halakhah 4, not an inferred Mishnah locator. Ashtor is a conventional vocalization of עשתור; its sense as name or place is not settled. Earlier machine OCR had יא ה״ר rather than supplied פ״א ה״ד.
This renders Hyman’s supplied citation; its occurrence and edition-specific locator have not been independently checked.
